title: Customer Support Executive
jobDescription:
Job Location : Pune Experience Required : 1 years to 4 years Required Educational background : Good Communication Skills in English language. Good Listening & Problem-Solving Skills. Ability to take and handle stress and pressure. Good Interpersonal Skills. Exhibiting patience in order to appease the most difficult clients. Following through on inquiries to ensure completion and satisfaction of work. Negotiating acceptable terms for both the company and the customer. Job

ROLE:
As a customer support executive you will be responsible for ensuring customer satisfaction and retention by addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and providing assistance to customers. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
A professional approach in answering calls and providing information about products and services, taking input of issues and their redressal thereof. Maintaining records of transactions and interactions. Appropriate and timely follow-ups wherever required. Escalate unresolved queries to respective departments for accurate redressal. Familiar with CRM systems and practices.

title: General Manager Operations
jobDescription:
Dhan Info is an IT enabled service company. We provide Digital Marketing, Data processing, Quality Control and Property Preservation & Inspections processing services. We are a team of young passionate individuals providing highly qualitative, timely delivered and cost-effective back office services. We started in 2007 as an individual and today, with over 900+ employees, we offer a complete solution to our worldwide customers at the lowest possible cost and turnaround time . Position Overview: We are seeking an experienced Operations Head / Delivery Head with over 14 years of experience in the BPO industry, specializing in international markets, particularly the US market. The candidate will be responsible for leading largescale operations, ensuring high service delivery standards, optimizing performance metrics, and driving operational excellence across multiple processes and teams. The role requires strong leadership, strategic planning, stakeholder management, and expertise in managing US-based clients, SLAs, KPIs, and large operations teams. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Operations Management ∙ Lead end-to-end BPO delivery operations for US-based clients. ∙ Manage multiple processes, teams, and operational units. ∙ Ensure achievement of SLAs, KPIs, and client deliverables Client & Stakeholder Management ∙ Act as the primary point of contact for international clients (US market). ∙ Conduct regular business reviews and performance discussions with clients. ∙ Build strong relationships to drive client satisfaction and account growth. Team Leadership ∙ Lead and mentor Operations Managers, Team Leaders, and support ∙ functions. ∙ Manage large teams across shifts and ensure productivity and engagement. ∙ Drive a high-performance culture. Process Improvement & Strategy ∙ Identify opportunities for process optimization, automation, and efficiency ∙ improvements. ∙ Implement Lean, Six Sigma, and best practices for operational excellence. ∙ Develop and execute operational strategies aligned with company goals. Performance Management ∙ Monitor operational metrics such as AHT, CSAT, FCR, Quality, Productivity, ∙ and Attrition. ∙ Develop action plans to improve performance and maintain quality standards. Financial & Resource Management ∙ Manage P&L, budgeting, forecasting, and cost optimization. ∙ Ensure optimal utilization of resources and workforce planning. Compliance & Quality Assurance ∙ Ensure adherence to industry compliance, security standards, and internal policies. ∙ Maintain quality benchmarks and regulatory compliance. Key Skills & Competencies: ∙ Strong experience in BPO Operations & Delivery Management ∙ Expertise in US market processes ∙ Client relationship management ∙ Strategic planning and execution ∙ Team leadership and people management ∙ Strong understanding of SLA/KPI management ∙ Process improvement methodologies (Lean / Six Sigma preferred) ∙ Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills Educational Qualification: ∙ Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Management, or related field ∙ MBA or equivalent qualification preferred

jobDescription: Job Title: Senior Business Development Manager Location: Nagpur, Maharashtra We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Senior Business Development Manager with strong experience in handling US clients, international business development, and social media-driven lead generation . The ideal candidate should possess expertise in sales strategy, client acquisition, AI-powered sales tools, CRM management, digital outreach, and revenue growth. The candidate must have excellent communication, relationship-building, and strategic planning skills with a proven track record in generating business opportunities and closing deals in the US market. Key Responsibilities Drive end-to-end business development activities for US clients and international markets. Identify, generate, and convert new business opportunities through outbound sales, social media platforms, networking, and strategic partnerships. Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve revenue and business growth targets. Utilize Linked In, social media channels, and digital platforms for branding, lead generation, and client engagement. Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, stakeholders, and decision makers. Handle lead generation, prospecting, proposal creation, negotiation, and deal closure. Utilize AI-powered tools and modern sales technologies for lead generation, automation, market research, and customer engagement. Manage and optimize Hub Spot CRM for pipeline tracking, reporting, customer relationship management, and sales analytics. Work closely with recruitment, operations, marketing, and leadership teams to align business objectives and delivery expectations. Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and identify new growth opportunities. Prepare sales reports, MIS, forecasting, and performance analytics for management review. Represent the organization in client meetings, virtual presentations, webinars, and business discussions. Ensure high levels of client satisfaction, retention, and long-term business partnerships. Preferred Tools & Technologies Hub Spot CRM Chat GPT & AI Productivity Tools Linked In Sales Navigator Apollo / Zoom Info / Lead Generation Tools Social Media Platforms & Digital Outreach Tools MS Excel, Power Point, and Reporting Tools Email Automation & Sales Engagement Platforms Qualification Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, or related field. MBA in Sales, Marketing, or International Business preferred. Preferred Candidate Profile Proven experience working with US-based clients and international stakeholders. Strong understanding of US business culture, communication standards, and sales processes. Experience in IT Services, Staffing, Recruitment, Digital Marketing, or Consulting industry preferred. Candidates from Nagpur or nearby locations will be preferred. Immediate joiners or candidates with short notice periods preferred.

title: Quality Assistant Manager (AM)
jobDescription: Dhan Info is an IT-enabled services company offering end-to-end solutions in Digital Marketing, Data Processing, Quality Control, and Property Preservation & Inspection Processing Services. Founded in 2007, Dhan Info has grown from an individual venture into a team of 800+ professionals , providing high-quality, timely, and cost-effective back-office solutions to global clients. Our mission is to deliver excellence through process innovation, operational efficiency, and long-term client partnerships. About the Role The role will involve managing, coaching, and enabling a tenured QC team by driving productivity, audit accuracy, professional maturity, and consistent performance through regular reviews and calibration discussions. The position will require close collaboration with Operations teams to recommend corrective and preventive actions, track closure of action items, and ensure improvements are practical, measurable, and sustainable. The role will act as the single point of contact for quality-related discussions, including internal calibrations, leadership reviews, and client or stakeholder quality interactions when required. Key Skills & Competencies Strong analytical and reporting mindset Ability to connect data with operational reality Excellent stakeholder communication skills Decision-making and problem-solving orientation Ability to manage tenured team members with maturity Ability to upscale and stabilize a newly formed quality team Experience & Background 6–10 years of experience in Quality / Audit / Compliance / Operations Governance Prior experience managing QC or audit teams preferred Exposure to BPO / BFSI / Mortgage / risk-controlled environments is a plus Strong knowledge of Power BI and quality tools.

title: Accounts Payable/Accounts Receivable Executive (US Accounting) Night shift
jobDescription:
Dhaninfo is an IT enabled service company. We provide Digital Marketing, Data processing, Quality Control and Property Preservation & Inspections processing services. We are a team of young passionate individuals providing highly qualitative, timely delivered and cost-effective back-office services. We started in 2007 as an individual and today, with over 700 employees, we offer a complete solution to our worldwide customers at the lowest possible cost and turnaround time. Job

ROLE:
As an AP/AR Executive ,
We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented U.S. Accounts Payable / Accounts Receivable Executive to manage end-to-end AP and AR functions, with a strong understanding of U.S. GAAP, sales tax, 1099 compliance, and credit management. You will be responsible for ensuring financial accuracy and compliance by maintaining records, preparing reports, and managing financial transactions. Your role will involve addressing accounting inquiries, resolving discrepancies, and providing financial assistance to ensure smooth financial operations and compliance with applicable regulations. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Accounts Payable (AP): Process vendor invoices accurately and in compliance with U.S. accounting standards and internal controls. Match purchase orders, receipts, and invoices, and investigate discrepancies. • Schedule and process ACH, wire transfers, and check payments to U.S. vendors. • Ensure proper documentation for IRS reporting, including W-9 and 1099 forms. • Reconcile AP ledger and assist in month-end and year-end close processes. Accounts Receivable (AR): Generate and issue invoices to U.S.-based customers based on sales orders or service contracts. • Apply customer payments (checks, ACH, credit cards) to appropriate invoices. • Monitor aging reports and perform proactive collections to ensure timely payment. • Resolve billing disputes and respond to customer inquiries professionally. Maintain accurate AR records and prepare reports for internal stakeholders. Maintain accurate financial records and ensure compliance with US GAAP. • Prepare and review financial statements, reports, and tax filings. Manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, and general ledger functions. • Perform monthly, quarterly, and year-end closing activities, including Reconciliation, Accruals, and Month-end Reporting . Reconcile bank statements and ensure accuracy in financial reporting. Stay updated on changes in tax laws and accounting regulations. Work on Record-to-Report (R2R) processes to enhance financial reporting and compliance. Required Experience and skills: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 2–4 years of experience in accounts payable and receivable, with U.S. clients or vendors. • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, sales/use tax, and 1099 reporting. Proficient in accounting systems (e.g., Quick Books, Net Suite, SAP, Oracle). • Strong knowledge of US GAAP and tax regulations. Proficiency in accounting software such as Quick Books, Net Suite, or SAP. Knowledge of RTR (Record-to-Report), General Accounting, and Reconciliation is highly desirable.
